notes: Datasheet SLCS005AH covers LM393B/LM2903B/LM193/LM293/LM293A/LM393/LM393A/LM2903/LM2903V. Reference variant is plain LM393 (section 5.8, page 8; column shared 'LM293 / LM393'); LM193 column, LM393A (5.9), LM393B (5.5) and LM2903 tables are excluded. Switching 5.11 (page 10) applies to LM193/LM293/LM393/LM2903 non-B versions. IOL '6' assigned to MIN column based on word x-position (right-aligned with other MIN values). VIO full-range row shows only max. VICR values are expressions ('0 to VCC – 1.5', '0 to VCC – 2') -> null. IIB printed negative (–25 typ, –250 max). ABS_MAX/RECOMMENDED rows use Non-B / non-V values. Outputs are open-collector (pull-up required; RL 5.1kΩ in switching test). Pin table spells '1IN–' (en-dash) but '2IN-' (hyphen). The 8-pin D/P pinout is identical for all variants; DSG thermal pad not part of the reference package. LM393B has separate switching table 5.7 (page 7) with tPHL/tPLH which is not included.
